A1.justification: Both PDFs describe FruitNinja. The complete main texts and Appendix A, including equations, tables and figures, support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original six-object experiments, quantitative comparisons in Tables 1–2, component ablations and generated examples in Appendix A.

after.justification: v3 retains the original quantitative comparisons, component ablations and generated-object results, including Appendix A.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain Gaussian filling, depth-conditioned SDS, optional DreamBooth fine-tuning, progressive refinement, voxel smoothing and OpaqueAtom GS. No algorithmic component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate watermelon, apple, orange, pomegranate, bread and red velvet cake under canonical slicing and arbitrary geometry edits. The revised appendix illustrations retain this coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains PhysGaussian and ordinary and fine-tuned 2D inpainting. Table 2 retains PhysGaussian and 2D inpainting. No evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: The reconstruction data, training schedules, evaluation metrics and 120 random cuts for consistency evaluation remain unchanged. Appendix A retains the same cross-section orientations and slice counts for all six objects.

E4.justification: The progressive-refinement, atomic-clipping/opacity and voxel-smoothing ablations retain their settings and findings. The appendix continues illustrating the same arbitrary-edit cases without introducing a new robustness or diagnostic analysis.

E5.justification: Both retain the same averaging practices and provide no repeated-run counts, seed reporting, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: Figure 12 replaces the cake's arbitrary-edit renderings, revising a limited set of qualitative outputs. Both numerical tables and the main-text result images are unchanged, including FruitNinja's Table 1 CLIP score of 33.1 and Table 2 cosine similarity of 0.96.

T1.justification: Equations 1–6 and their definitions and mathematical reasoning are unchanged. Neither version adds formal propositions, proofs or derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same novelty claim, real-time rendering without additional optimization, fine-grained interior texture generation and claimed superiority over existing approaches.

C2.justification: Appendix A newly explains that the four fruits use two cross-section types because their internal structures are more complex. v1 already reported those configurations but lacked this rationale; other interpretations and qualifications remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details and Appendix A retain the same grid size, optimization steps, iteration ranges, fine-tuning data and slice specifications. Both state that code and datasets will be released upon publication, without new access information.

R1.justification: The same 44 cited works and substantive related-work positioning are retained. Changes to reference backlinks reflect pagination rather than added or removed research.

P1.justification: Appendix A is briefly rewritten, Figure 12's caption explicitly says vertical cross-sections, and the corresponding-author marker and footnote are removed. Main-text wording and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Paragraph spacing and indentation change, shifting text and figure placement. Figure 11 is cropped more tightly and Figure 12 refreshes its cake panels. The same twelve figures and two tables remain.

improvement.justification: v3 provides a small clarification of cross-section choices and refreshes appendix illustrations, while retaining the method, quantitative evidence, ablations and reproducibility information. These local explanatory and presentation refinements leave the paper's overall evidential strength and quality effectively unchanged.
